consent.title: A quick word on privacy
consent.text: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language. With your permission we also remember small preferences and count anonymous visits to improve the app.

consent.essentialText: Sign-in, security, your language and this choice. The app can't work without them.

consent.analyticsText: Counts which screens are used, without identifying you.
